What is AIGoalie?

🤖 An Artificial Intelligence (AI) model that predicts the winner of football matches and how many goals will be scored.

🏋 Trained on a lot of football data from many seasons and many leagues.

📚 Continues to learn and improve as more matches are played throughout the season, 24/7.

🌍 Presents you the most confident to the least confident predictions across all the leagues in the world.

🚨 Gives you additional important information, such as important player injuries.

🎯 Check out previous gameweeks

Let AIGoalie help you save time, keep you ahead of the game, and assist you in making informed decisions, completely free!

Please report any bugs or feature requests through our contact form! contact form

 
   
 

🌍 Global

Date Fixture Bold-faced team is selected by AIGoalie to win. Odds Pre-match odds of the selected team winning. Odds fetch daily at 00:00 GMT; some may be live. Win How confident AIGoalie is that the selected team will win. Low confidence indicates unpredictability. ▼ Result Whether the selected team won, drew, or lost. Over Minimum number of goals predicted by AIGoalie.
⚽ = over 0.5
⚽⚽ = over 1.5
⚽⚽⚽ = over 2.5

🏥🏥 = Major injuries

📉 = Dip in form

    What is AIGoalie?

    🤖 An Artificial Intelligence (AI) model that predicts the winner of football matches and how many goals will be scored.
